decisions.scope: Accented headwords and structured inflection fields used by an exact row. Dictionary rows are not a comparison, relative-clause, conditional, obligation, or motion curriculum.
Instrumental functions, noun endings, plural forms, adjective endings, governing prepositions, and exact source examples. Identity, role, and becoming complements are not stated.
Instrumental adjective examples reused from the frozen adjectives page. This page is not a Russian comparison source.
Cardinal context, ordinal list forms, and hour, year, and minute quantity lines. Telling time, weekdays, calendar dates, and age are not established.
Prefix cautions and source-supplied pairs. Conditional бы and должен are not established. Prefixes are not treated as mechanically predictable perfective markers.

Exact spans for instrumental complements, age, comparison, conditional бы, and selected motion pairs. The rest of the article is retained and is not a Unit 7 adverb paradigm, a clock-time answer, a calendar date, or a probability use of должен.
Seven weekday names and the capitalization sentence. Mnemonic stories are not learner text. Case government, scheduling, and date syntax are not stated.
Month names and English meanings only. Calendar-date syntax is not stated.
The clock question Который час? and source relative examples with который. Productive clock-time answers are not stated.
The obligation span for должен, должна, должно, and должны. The dolphin mnemonic and editorial asides are not learner text. Probability is not stated.
The three stated clock constructions and the times the sentence binds to them: четверть восьмого is 7:15, полвосьмого is 7:30, and без четверти восемь is 7:45. No other hour is admitted.

Written day-month-year order, the expanded 28 августа 2017 г. form with г short for года, and the spoken ordinal day plus genitive month in Двадцать восьмое августа. Other dates, 09/15/2024, and a year on the spoken example are not admitted.
The vocabulary link titled Verbs of Motion is a red link. It is not an instructional source and has no frozen bytes.
The previously frozen general verb page is not a unidirectional or multidirectional motion curriculum.
The private owned PDF is an observation source only. Its prose, examples, exercises, and page images are not admitted.

The likelihood sense of должен and its example Затмение должно наступить в три часа / The eclipse should occur at three o'clock, plus the obligation contrast on the same frozen entry. Not audio, not quotations, and not every должен sense.
At-what-time patterns for 0.00, 0.15, 0.30, and 0.45 only. Does not clear productive-clock-time or arbitrary minutes.
Adverb invariance and the two suffixal pairs. Does not clear adverb-paradigm.

The stated clock system and the three exact first-hour examples in the retained Grammar 20 HTML. Later quarter, half, and minutes-before Russian forms, linked audio, and the clock web application are not admitted.
